d_amount_sum_by_qty_count.sql:
-- Compute Metrics via Expressions
-- Write to DataTable
SELECT
  metric_time__day
  , sale__store_id
  , amount_sum / qty_count AS d_amount_sum_by_qty_count
FROM (
  -- Aggregate Inputs for Simple Metrics
  -- Compute Metrics via Expressions
  SELECT
    metric_time__day
    , sale__store_id
    , SUM(__amount_sum) AS amount_sum
    , SUM(__qty_count) AS qty_count
  FROM (
    -- Read Elements From Semantic Model 'sales'
    -- Metric Time Dimension 'date'
    -- Select: ['__amount_sum', '__qty_count', 'sale__store_id', 'metric_time__day']
    -- Select: ['__amount_sum', '__qty_count', 'sale__store_id', 'metric_time__day']
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('day', date) AS metric_time__day
      , store_id AS sale__store_id
      , amount AS __amount_sum
      , CASE WHEN qty IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __qty_count
    FROM "parity"."dm"."sales" sales_src_10000
  ) subq_3
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__day
    , sale__store_id
) subq_5
